## [Godox iM30Pro Camera Flash Announced](https://photofocus.com/photography/godox-im30pro-camera-flash-announced/)
*Photofocus* | 08/06/2026 | Score: 0.86
Tags: photography, camera, photography_technique

> Small Flash, Big Possibilities Godox has announced the new iM30Pro, a compact camera flash that combines a classic vintage-inspired design with a range of modern features aimed at photographers who want a simple, portable lighting solution. Designed for street photographers, travel shooters, film photography enthusiasts, and everyday creators, the iM30Pro offers an easy way to add artificial light without the bulk often associated with traditional speedlights. One of the standout features is the adjustable flash head, which can be tilted to 45°, 60°, 75°, and 90°. This allows photographers to move beyond direct flash and experiment with bounced light for softer, more flattering illumination. For anyone photographing people indoors, shooting events, or working in low light, this added flexibility can make a significant difference to the final image. The iM30Pro also introduces a Smart AUTO mode designed to simplify flash photography. Rather than manually calculating exposure, photographers simply set their camera’s ISO and aperture, and the flash automatically adjusts its output to achieve a balanced exposure. For beginners, or those who simply want to work quickly, this feature should make flash photography far less intimidating. Power comes from a built-in rechargeable lithium battery, eliminating the need to carry spare AA batteries. Godox claims up to 550 full-power flashes on a single charge, making it suitable for extended shooting sessions, travel, and day-to-day photography. Despite its compact size, the iM30Pro delivers a Guide Number of 15 (GN15) and offers manual power adjustment from full power down to 1/128 power in 1/3-stop increments. Recycle times range from just 0.1 to 1.5 seconds, helping photographers keep up with spontaneous moments and fast-moving subjects. Creative photographers will also appreciate compatibility with the Godox MA01 magnetic colour filters. These magnetic accessories can be attached quickly to add colour effects and creative lighting options without complicated setups. Compatibility is broad thanks to the universal single-contact hot shoe and standard PC sync port. Whether you’re shooting with a modern mirrorless camera, DSLR, or a classic film camera, the iM30Pro is designed to work across a wide range of systems. A colour display on the rear of the unit provides quick access to settings and flash information, while the compact dimensions of just 62 × 64 × 48mm and a weight of approximately 121g make it an easy addition to any camera bag. Key Features Specifications First Thoughts The iM30Pro looks like an interesting option for photographers who want something more capable than a basic on-camera flash, while still maintaining a compact footprint. The inclusion of bounce flash capability, automatic exposure control, and a rechargeable battery makes it particularly appealing for travel, street photography, casual portraits, and film camera users who want a simple lighting solution without carrying a full-sized speedlight. for full specifications, pricing and availability, visit the Godox website.
